worst pho ever
Oct 2026 • Business
The pho they served tasted like plain water with chewy beef. Absolutely no taste. I eat every week at least one pho on the street in any random pho restaurant. That's a disgrace to the number 1. My wife and me gave their soup back. and intended first our money back but they only said we. could choose another meal. so we got two banh Mi.... they were dry bread and dry meat... half hearted.
we know food on the airport is usually more expensive but it should be quality food. don't waste your money in this place.

Bahn mi from Temu
Feb 2025 • Solo
I am a long-time lover of banh mi, in all shapes and sizes. This, however, is not a banh mi. This is, simply put, an atrocity. 

To make it even worse, I’m a vegetarian now. The real thing is always going to be so much better, but sometimes the vegetarian alternatives get damn close (from the street vendors in town, in particular). So, I have the vegetarian banh mi a try. 

This was hands down the worst banh mi I’ve ever had in my life. I’m not even sure it could be considered banh mi?? Like the bread slapped (but come on, it’s bread). The filling was literally a gallon of mayonnaise, mysterious shredded vegetables, and.. wait for it.. melted American cheese with half a tomato slice on top?? I beg your pardon?? To make it even worse, I asked for my meal without coriander, and they still sprinkled my meal with the devils herb. 

Not impressed.
